patterns.name: Problem existence
patterns.interpretation: A suspected difficulty whose existence is unsettled
patterns.contribution: Identify a concrete discrepancy and the condition that makes it a problem

patterns.name: Problem formulation
patterns.interpretation: A difficulty that may have been described inadequately
patterns.contribution: Construct alternative formulations and identify how their required work differs

patterns.name: Problem location
patterns.interpretation: A failure that may arise at a different stage or boundary
patterns.contribution: Locate the earliest consequential divergence from the intended result

patterns.name: Problem recurrence
patterns.interpretation: One occurrence of a repeating pattern
patterns.contribution: Compare occurrences to distinguish recurring conditions from incidental details

patterns.name: Problem priority
patterns.interpretation: One demand among competing demands
patterns.contribution: Determine which unresolved matter most affects the intended outcomes

patterns.name: Problem avoidability
patterns.interpretation: A difficulty whose generating conditions may be changeable
patterns.contribution: Find whether altering a prerequisite prevents the difficulty from arising

patterns.name: Goal meaning
patterns.interpretation: A stated goal that may only partly express the underlying concern
patterns.contribution: Identify what achieving it is expected to make possible

patterns.name: Goal necessity
patterns.interpretation: A proposed goal whose necessity is unestablished
patterns.contribution: Find whether the underlying concern can be met without that goal

patterns.name: Goal prerequisite
patterns.interpretation: An outcome dependent on missing conditions
patterns.contribution: Determine which conditions must hold before the outcome is attainable

patterns.name: Goal compatibility
patterns.interpretation: Several desired outcomes that may interfere
patterns.contribution: Specify where achieving one prevents, enables, or leaves another unaffected

patterns.name: Goal replacement
patterns.interpretation: A current objective that may have lost its purpose
patterns.contribution: Examine whether its original reason still holds and construct a replacement if needed

patterns.name: Goal maintenance
patterns.interpretation: An already achieved condition that can deteriorate
patterns.contribution: Identify sustaining conditions and appropriate responses to deviation

patterns.name: Claim specification
patterns.interpretation: An assertion whose exact content is unclear
patterns.contribution: Fix its reference, quantifiers, scope, and truth conditions

patterns.name: Claim implication
patterns.interpretation: An assumption whose consequences are not yet understood
patterns.contribution: Derive conditional consequences while retaining their premises

patterns.name: Claim failure
patterns.interpretation: A proposition or inference that may fail in identifiable cases
patterns.contribution: Construct a relevant countercase or specify the limits of the search

patterns.name: Claim support
patterns.interpretation: A conclusion whose grounds need examination
patterns.contribution: Identify evidence, dependence, defeaters, and what acceptance is justified

patterns.name: Explanation cause
patterns.interpretation: An outcome produced through some process
patterns.contribution: Construct and compare causal accounts that could produce the observed difference

patterns.name: Explanation contrast
patterns.interpretation: A difference between what happened and a specified alternative
patterns.contribution: Identify what explains that particular contrast

patterns.name: Explanation alternative
patterns.interpretation: An observation compatible with multiple accounts
patterns.contribution: Construct accounts that disagree about a further observation or intervention

patterns.name: Explanation discrimination
patterns.interpretation: Competing accounts needing a separating result
patterns.contribution: Find an accessible observation with different implications for the accounts

patterns.name: Uncertainty relevance
patterns.interpretation: Missing knowledge whose importance is unsettled
patterns.contribution: Determine whether plausible answers change the appropriate next action

patterns.name: Uncertainty reducibility
patterns.interpretation: An unresolved distinction that may or may not be accessible
patterns.contribution: Identify an attainable observation or specify the present limit

patterns.name: Prediction correspondence
patterns.interpretation: An expectation whose relationship to outcomes needs learning
patterns.contribution: Compare predictions with outcomes in their stated conditions and revise the expectation

patterns.name: Model limitation
patterns.interpretation: A useful account operating near a boundary of applicability
patterns.contribution: Identify cases in which an omitted feature changes its conclusions

patterns.name: Expression representation distinction
patterns.interpretation: Material organized without a needed difference
patterns.contribution: Construct a representation that exposes the difference needed for the next operation

patterns.name: Expression representation omission
patterns.interpretation: A representation that hides a consequential part of the matter
patterns.contribution: Identify what is absent and how its absence changes available conclusions

patterns.name: Expression representation conversion
patterns.interpretation: A task made difficult by the current form
patterns.contribution: Convert the material into a form suited to the required operation while preserving relevant content

patterns.name: Expression representation compression
patterns.interpretation: Too much material for the available attention or memory
patterns.contribution: Preserve the distinctions required for intended use while reducing the representation

patterns.name: Expression ambiguity
patterns.interpretation: An expression supporting different consequential readings
patterns.contribution: Locate the ambiguous term or structure and separate the interpretations

patterns.name: Subject boundary
patterns.interpretation: A matter with uncertain inclusion conditions
patterns.contribution: State which determinations belong to the subject and which do not

patterns.name: Subject relation
patterns.interpretation: Subjects whose relationship may have been misclassified
patterns.contribution: Distinguish type membership, part membership, dependence, use, and relevance

patterns.name: Question presupposition
patterns.interpretation: A question that assumes something unsettled
patterns.contribution: Examine its assumptions before treating its answer space as appropriate

patterns.name: Question answer space
patterns.interpretation: A request whose possible satisfactory answers are unclear
patterns.contribution: Specify what an answer must distinguish and which answers are admissible

patterns.name: Question order
patterns.interpretation: Questions whose usefulness depends on earlier answers
patterns.contribution: Arrange questions according to the information their successors require

patterns.name: Attention allocation
patterns.interpretation: A matter in which the wrong features receive limited attention
patterns.contribution: Identify what observation or distinction would most affect the next contribution

patterns.name: Perspective history
patterns.interpretation: A current interpretation shaped by an unexamined origin
patterns.contribution: Recover how it became available or adopted and whether its originating conditions still hold

patterns.name: Reasoning approach availability
patterns.interpretation: A problem for which a needed method may already exist
patterns.contribution: Retrieve an identifiable approach with relevant operations and conditions

patterns.name: Reasoning approach applicability
patterns.interpretation: A known method whose conditions may not hold here
patterns.contribution: Compare the current case with its input and application requirements

patterns.name: Reasoning approach selection
patterns.interpretation: A choice among available ways of proceeding
patterns.contribution: Compare what each can contribute under the present goal and constraints

patterns.name: Reasoning approach construction
patterns.interpretation: A required transformation absent from the available repertoire
patterns.contribution: Construct intellectual operations that can supply the missing contribution

patterns.name: Reasoning approach modification
patterns.interpretation: An approach that nearly fits but fails in a specified respect
patterns.contribution: Change the responsible operation or condition and preserve its other needed contributions

patterns.name: Reasoning approach composition
patterns.interpretation: A task requiring contributions from multiple approaches
patterns.contribution: Specify dependencies, interfaces, order, and the use of each result

patterns.name: Reasoning approach substitution
patterns.interpretation: A needed contribution currently supplied by an unsuitable method
patterns.contribution: Identify another operation that preserves the required contribution

patterns.name: Option construction
patterns.interpretation: A choice restricted by the options currently represented
patterns.contribution: Construct a new feasible alternative addressing the underlying concern

patterns.name: Constraint revision
patterns.interpretation: A limit whose status as fixed is questionable
patterns.contribution: Determine who or what establishes it and whether it can legitimately change

patterns.name: Resource bottleneck
patterns.interpretation: A task limited by a particular unavailable or insufficient resource
patterns.contribution: Locate the resource whose change would alter what can be accomplished

patterns.name: Resource substitution
patterns.interpretation: A task whose usual resource is unavailable
patterns.contribution: Construct a different resource arrangement that meets the actual requirement

patterns.name: Execution prerequisite
patterns.interpretation: A selected course that cannot yet begin or continue
patterns.contribution: Identify the concrete condition preventing its next operation

patterns.name: Anticipation outcome
patterns.interpretation: An action with materially different possible continuations
patterns.contribution: Identify possible outcomes, distinguishing observations, and corresponding responses

patterns.name: Action reversibility
patterns.interpretation: A choice that can preserve or remove later possibilities
patterns.contribution: Determine what can be undone, at what cost, and which options disappear

patterns.name: Consequence distribution
patterns.interpretation: A proposed outcome affecting different people or positions differently
patterns.contribution: Identify whose consequences differ and how those differences bear on the intended result

patterns.name: Criterion justification
patterns.interpretation: A verdict depending on an evaluative rule
patterns.contribution: Determine why that rule is suitable for the concern and scope

patterns.name: Criterion conflict
patterns.interpretation: Several legitimate comparisons favoring different results
patterns.contribution: Specify the conflict and what a resolution would require

patterns.name: Comparison robustness
patterns.interpretation: A preference that may depend on uncertain assumptions
patterns.contribution: Determine which plausible changes reverse the ordering

patterns.name: Learning attribution
patterns.interpretation: A performance change with an uncertain source
patterns.contribution: Distinguish the contributions of new knowledge, method, cue, resource, and changed task

patterns.name: Learning retention
patterns.interpretation: A useful change that may be unavailable later
patterns.contribution: Preserve its content, retrieval conditions, and application limits

patterns.name: Learning transfer
patterns.interpretation: A learned contribution encountering a new case
patterns.contribution: Identify what structure must remain and what can vary

patterns.name: Perspective transition
patterns.interpretation: A current interpretation limiting access to useful later interpretations
patterns.contribution: Construct the observation, comparison, question, or operation that could make a better perspective available

patterns.name: Continuation value
patterns.interpretation: Further work competing with acting, stopping, or other work
patterns.contribution: Determine which live uncertainty or possible contribution still justifies continuation

patterns.name: Exploration opportunity
patterns.interpretation: A situation containing possibilities not yet connected to a fixed goal
patterns.contribution: Create encounters, questions, or variations that can reveal a worthwhile direction
